edit this text to jasmine, friendly but firm. need her to swap a shift in 2 weeks so i can go to the paid 8 hr charting class on sept 9, need that night covered

"hey jas, so i have this charting class on sept 9 and i was kind of hoping maybe you could possibly take my shift that night? no worries at all if not, i totally understand, i know everyone's busy and i hate to ask, sorry!!"

Here's a cleaner version:

"Hey Jas, I have a paid 8-hour charting class on Sept 9 and need that night covered. Can you take my shift? Happy to swap one of yours in return. Let me know either way!"

It's friendly, clear about the date and the ask, and offers something back. Want it shorter or a different tone?
make it shorter. also dont suggest any times before 3pm, i'm asleep. i sleep after shifts

Shorter:

"Hey Jas, I have a paid charting class Sept 9 and need that night covered. Can you take my shift? I'll swap one of yours back. Text me whenever."

I left out any specific times, so nothing lands before 3 p.m. If you want to propose a time to talk it over, I'd say 'after 3' or 'this evening'.
You're welcome! Good luck with the swap, and enjoy the class.
